title: At the Regent's Chambers, after I refused to help burn the Hollow Throne, Regent Ysolde says 'The stair is barred and the archivist is loyal... it can wait past you' — but Archivist Penn had already handed me the barred-stair key earlier that same visit, so the stair was not in fact barred to me. Line contradicts what I'd already done.
where: The Regent's Chambers, Marrowgate / dialogue with Regent Ysolde
